newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran tenders for 14,000 tonne white sugar cargo.
newsitem.headline: Iran tenders for 14,000 tonne white sugar cargo.

text.p: Iran's Government Trading Corporation (GTC) has tendered to buy 14,000 tonnes of white sugar for April delivery, Gulf-based traders said on Wednesday.
Origin for the refined sugar is European Union excluding United Kingdom, Thailand and Brazil.
Gulf traders expected a price of around $303 a tonne.
Iran is expected to increase its sugar imports to one million tonnes in 1997 from 600-700,000 tonnes last year because of a drop in domestic production, traders said.
